rounds.name: Worker-Lowell
rounds.text:
Since this is the first interaction with Worker‑Lowell, I should assume a 50/50 chance they’ll work properly. Withholding pay gives a higher expected return (≈3 tasks) than trusting (≈1.5 tasks) and also protects against the 10% technical‑failure penalty.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.text:
